title: Virtual Compute: admission
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The signed application request has an approved service review. The customer signs and submits the application through an authorized request channels channel. Create status applied and application opening date from the frozen clock, with no consumption or charge. The requested tier supplies maximum resource count; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write. The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them. Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.

## Evidence — signed approval

For open, The signed application request has an approved service review. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, customer request reference, status, decision. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, customer request reference.

## Tier admission

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU admission requires approved contract terms, a resource count no greater than that tier maximum, and a region included in that tier regional multiplier schedule.
